title: Read a statement parser
description: You can follow token consumption through a parser for print and let statements.

steps.description: Token stores a kind, lexeme, and line. tokenize skips matched whitespace, records tokens, and appends EOF.
The parser keeps a position in its token list. expect checks the requested kind before advancing.
parse_stmt selects a statement method using the next keyword. Each method reads its supplied statement form and returns a tuple.

steps.question: Does the expression stub convert a numeric lexeme to int or float?
steps.answer: It converts both INT and FLOAT lexemes to float.

steps.description: The stub accepts one number or identifier. A token outside those kinds takes its error branch.
The demonstration displays successful results for the first two inputs. The third input reaches the SyntaxError handler, leaving its diagnostic analysis to the exercise.
